# OpenAI Norm module provenance

The `.norm` files in this directory are copied without source changes from `norm/libraries/openai/` in [normlanguage/Norm](https://github.com/normlanguage/Norm), as present at commit `6c3e1c5` (after tag `v0.24.0`). Their SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded in [`dependencies.lock.json`](../../dependencies.lock.json).
